name: Summit AZ - Pre-Redesign Baseline 2026-09-03
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-03

# Summary
The locked "before" baseline for the Sep 3, 2026 relaunch: Aug 7 to Sep 3 (28 full days before the Sep 4 launch), captured read-only on Sep 11. Do not edit; later changes go in the change log and are compared against this file. It is the Phase 1A baseline of the case study.

# Property checks
- One GSC property (URL prefix www), one WordPress install on SiteGround, OTTO project UUID 1c548117, Rank Math active (1.0.277.2), Yoast and MetaSync inactive, OTTO pixel not installed.
- Before launch, SEO tags were served by MetaSync from OTTO values; after launch, Rank Math plus two mu-plugins (`summit-location-seo`, `summit-service-schema`) output schema. Redirects live in the Redirection plugin (32 rules).

# Key numbers (GSC web UI, Aug 7 to Sep 3)
- 37 clicks, 10,280 impressions, CTR 0.36%, average position 26.0, 744 queries, 142 pages.
- Desktop 20 clicks at 28.4; mobile 17 at 23.2.
- Every visible click was branded (15 of 15); non-branded visible queries: 6,288 impressions, 0 clicks.
- Intent: local service 2,803 impressions, emergency 1,545 (mostly "emergency plumber tempe"), 24/7 wording 299 (not offered, do not target), outside service area 589.
- Page types: homepage 19 clicks; 113 city pages 6 clicks on 5,684 impressions; emergency city pages only 33 impressions.

# GA4 (property 459518259, Aug 12 to Sep 3, from uploaded PDFs)
- 250 sessions (111 organic), organic engagement rate 77.5%, 3 key events. GA4 recorded zero data from Sep 4 (tag switched to the Utah property), so no window after launch is comparable.

# Data files folded in
- `Summit-AZ-Page-Baseline-2026-09-10.csv`: 273 URLs (sitemap pages, legacy, noindexed, 54 trashed Utah pages) with old and new post IDs, status and GSC data.
- `Summit-AZ-Keyword-Baseline-2026-09-10.csv`: 962 queries with brand, intent, service, city and pre/post windows.
- `Summit-AZ-Technical-Baseline-2026-09-10.csv`: 35 technical checks, pre vs post redesign.
